test_title: PYST 81: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 01 Mar, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
'A × B' means 'A is the wife of B'

'A + B' means 'A is the brother of B'

'A ÷ B' means 'A is the sister of B'

'A - B' means 'A is the son of B'

How is T related to R in the expression 'T × S + P - R'?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Brother
 Son
 Wife 
 Sister
 
 

 

Given: T × S + P - R

It means: T is the wife of S, S is the brother of P, and P is the son of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80e92557798d5d7c6646a2bcb39b80abf1f2a260b2269234023ea5015750dcaf.png] 

So, T is the 'Son’s wife' of R.

Hence, the correct answer is "Son’s wife".
